text:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — Vector Systems (SI) flagged failures for SunGrid after this morning's marketplace image rollover. Private deploys hitting image pull 403s and signature verify failing during init. Need quick arch triage + escalation.

Liam Ortiz: On it. Which path — marketplace image proxy or dedicated marketplace integration?

Rahul (Vector SI): Private marketplace proxy. We saw token rejected across a handful of clusters ~09:03 UTC. Example from proxy: `GET /v2/sungrid/app/manifests/sha256:... 403` and verifier: `signature_verifier: decrypt error: AccessDenied`.

Eve Nakamura: Likely token rotation mismatch + KMS permissions. Can Vector share the renewer run timeline?

Rahul (Vector SI): Rewnewer executed at 09:00 UTC and again at 09:01 for a full sweep. We suspect the proxy didn't pick up the new secret in time and the verifier couldn't access KMS with the new service principal.

Jorge Mendes: Can someone paste a failing pod describe/logs? Also confirm whether image signature verification runs as a sidecar or init.

Rahul (Vector SI): Init container fails before main container starts. Pasted snippet: ``Events:
  Warning Failed  Failed to pull image "private-registry/sungrid/app:stable": rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc="authorization failed"`` and verifier: ``ERROR: kms.Decrypt AccessDenied for principal svc-vector-verifier@vector-prod``.

Priya Nair: Immediate mitigation: Vector can re-deploy proxy with previous token to recover pods. Need Redwood approval to access proxy logs and to coordinate renewer rollback if necessary.

Liam Ortiz: I'll fetch proxy logs + renewer audit trail. Also check if the renewer changed token TTL/prefix which might break our secret sync path.

Eve Nakamura: Architecture checklist for the incident:
- Confirm renewer write path (vault -> proxy secret) and whether proxy watches or polls.
- Validate KMS key policy includes `svc-vector-verifier` and Redwood verification role.
- Check if marketplace header `X-Marketplace-ID` was preserved during rollover (affects analytics).
- Confirm region affinity: KMS key in `us-west-2` but verifier in `eu-west-1` would fail if not replicated.

ops-bot: Incident created: #inc-2026-03-22-marketplace-proxy-403 (severity: high).

Jorge Mendes: If this is global, we should gate renewer to a canary flow. Samless rollback of renewer for all customers is risky. Need a kill-switch on renewer that preserves existing tokens until proxies confirm update.

Priya Nair: Assigning tasks:
- Liam: collect and paste the logs + renewer audit (ETA 20m).
- Rahul: prepare a canary proxy redeploy with previous token and report health (ETA 10m).
- Eve: validate KMS key policies & region replication with Vector (ETA 25m).
- Priya: notify GTM and Partnerships leads for possible joint customer comms (ETA 30m).

Rahul (Vector SI): Canary redeploy started at 2971110045. Will report when replicas are healthy.

Liam Ortiz: Pulling support bundle now. If logs show `AccessDenied` for `kms:Decrypt` include the `principal` and `keyId`.

Eve Nakamura: Also check the proxy image version — we had a config watch bug in `priv-proxy:v3.1.0` that missed secret updates when token format changed. If they're on that, swap to `:v3.0.5` which polls every 30s.

Rahul (Vector SI): Proxy was on `priv-proxy:v3.1.0`. Canary rolled to `v3.0.5` with old token. Initial health: 2/2 init containers succeeded and pods started. We'll monitor for 15m and then decide whether to flip traffic.

Priya Nair: Good catch Eve. That explains the timing mismatch. Follow-ups after stabilization: 1) add schema check for token format in renewer, 2) add automated rollback to previous token if >5% clusters report 403 within 5m.

ops-bot: Deployment action: rollback toggle created for renewer service (id: toggle-8842).

Liam Ortiz: Logs show `AccessDenied: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333444:key/abcd-ef01` and principal `svc-vector-verifier@vector-prod`. KMS key policy missing a `Decrypt` statement for that principal.

Eve Nakamura: Vector — can you add that principal to the key policy or create an IAM role that the verifier assumes? If they need help, we can propose the exact policy snippet.

Rahul (Vector SI): We'll work with our infra to update policy. For now, canary is healthy and customer pods are running. We'll keep monitoring and open a postmortem with both teams.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. I'll draft a short joint update for SunGrid and loop in Partnerships + GTM. We'll reconvene if canary shows any regressions. :raised_hands:
